title: Misery
author: Stephen King
summary: Novelist Paul Sheldon is pulled from a car wreck by his self-described number-one fan, who nurses him in her remote house. When she reads his latest manuscript, she makes him rewrite it.
readIf: you want a tight, two-person thriller about obsession and trapped creativity.
skipIf: you are uncomfortable with graphic physical cruelty or captivity stories.

pairings.reason: More King with a writer, an isolated place and a mind coming apart, in a more supernatural form.
Another thriller built around a captor who seems charming from the outside.
A confined-protagonist suspense novel with an unreliable view of what is real.
